### Modifications in Each File

   - **Line 238**: The Javadoc comment for the `cleanup` method was modified to change the wording from "ignore any {@link IOException}" to "ignore any {@link Throwable}". This broadens the scope of exceptions that are ignored during cleanup.
   - **Line 258**: The Javadoc comment for the `closeStream` method was similarly modified to change "ignoring {@link IOException}" to "ignoring {@link Throwable}". This also broadens the exception handling for stream closing.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in the `IOUtils.java` file are related in that they both update the Javadoc comments for methods that handle resource cleanup and closing. By changing the references from `IOException` to `Throwable`, the patch enhances the robustness of the methods by indicating that they will now ignore all types of exceptions, not just IO-related ones. This change suggests a more comprehensive approach to error handling during resource management in the context of exception handling.
